why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two numbered checks, one for each expect line: Check 1 is the TSV vs CSV diff and Check 2 is the README grep. Neither PASS nor FAIL condition requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass. Check 1 passes only on the diff, the exit codes and the expected JSON. Check 2 passes on grep output that explains what --tsv does. npm test and the no-flag behaviour appear only under "Advisory (does not decide PASS or FAIL)". That section says outright that it does not decide the verdict, so it is not a third check. The builder brief does ask the builder to run npm test, but the must_not list only restricts the verifier's checks and its PASS/FAIL conditions. Neither forbidden item appears.
